note: Public task instructions the EXP10A RoboTwin arms delivered, one per task; collected from the development line's experiment packages on 2026-09-30 for the official suite and moved here from experiments/official_suite_v1/robotwin-instructions.json on 2026-10-05 (task entries unchanged), so maintained RunSpec builders read them without importing an experiment package. Tasks marked seed_named take their instruction from a public episode-names file.

adjust_bottle.instruction: Pick up the bottle on the table and hold it head up.

beat_block_hammer.instruction: Grab the hammer on the table and beat the block with it.

blocks_ranking_rgb.instruction: Move the three blocks to the center of the table and arrange them red, green and blue from left to right.

blocks_ranking_size.instruction: Move the three blocks to the center of the table and arrange them from largest to smallest, from left to right.

click_alarmclock.instruction: Click the button on the top of the alarm clock.

click_bell.instruction: Click the top center of the bell.

dump_bin_bigbin.instruction: Grab the small bin and pour the balls into the big bin.

grab_roller.instruction: Use both arms to grab the roller on the table.

handover_block.instruction: Grasp the red block with the left arm, hand it over to the right arm and place it on the blue pad.

handover_mic.instruction: Grasp the microphone with one arm and hand it over to the other arm.

hanging_mug.instruction: Pick up the mug with the left arm, rotate it and set it down in the middle of the table, then hang it on the rack with the right arm.

lift_pot.instruction: Use both arms to lift the pot.

move_can_pot.instruction: Pick up the can and move it beside the pot.

move_pillbottle_pad.instruction: Use one arm to pick up the pill bottle and place it onto the pad.

move_playingcard_away.instruction: Pick up the playing card and move it away from the near edge of the table.

move_stapler_pad.instruction: Move the stapler to a colored mat.

open_laptop.instruction: Use one arm to open the laptop.

open_microwave.instruction: Use one arm to open the microwave.

pick_diverse_bottles.instruction: Pick up one bottle with one arm and the other bottle with the other arm.

pick_dual_bottles.instruction: Pick up one bottle with one arm and the other bottle with the other arm.

place_a2b_left.note: The public instruction names the two objects the seed spawns; supply it per (task, seed) through --episode-names.

place_a2b_right.note: The public instruction names the two objects the seed spawns; supply it per (task, seed) through --episode-names.

place_bread_basket.instruction: Put every bread on the table into the basket.

place_bread_skillet.instruction: Put the bread on the table into the skillet.

place_burger_fries.instruction: Use both arms to pick up the hamburger and the fries and put them onto the tray.

place_can_basket.instruction: Put the can into the basket with one arm, then lift the basket with the other arm.

place_cans_plasticbox.instruction: Use both arms to pick up the cans and place them into the plastic box.

place_container_plate.instruction: Place the container onto the plate.

place_dual_shoes.instruction: Use both arms to put the two shoes into the shoe box with the shoe tips pointing left.

place_empty_cup.instruction: Place the empty cup on the coaster.

place_fan.instruction: Grab the fan and place it on a colored mat, facing the robot.

place_mouse_pad.instruction: Grab the mouse and place it on a colored mat.

place_object_basket.instruction: Put the target object into the basket, then grab the basket with the other arm and move it slightly away.

place_object_scale.instruction: Use one arm to grab the object and put it on the scale.

place_object_stand.instruction: Place the object on the stand.

place_phone_stand.instruction: Pick up the phone and put it on the phone stand.

place_shoe.instruction: Use one arm to grab the shoe from the table and place it on the mat.

press_stapler.instruction: Use one arm to press the stapler.

put_bottles_dustbin.instruction: Grab the bottles and put them into the dustbin to the left of the table.

put_object_cabinet.instruction: Open the cabinet drawer with one arm and use the other arm to put the object on the table into the drawer.

rotate_qrcode.instruction: Pick up the QR code board and rotate it so the code faces you.

scan_object.instruction: Pick up the scanner with one arm and the object with the other, then scan the object.

shake_bottle.instruction: Shake the bottle with the appropriate arm.

shake_bottle_horizontally.instruction: Shake the bottle horizontally with the appropriate arm.

stack_blocks_three.instruction: Move the three blocks to the center of the table and stack the blue block on the green block and the green block on the red block.

stack_blocks_two.instruction: Move the two blocks to the center of the table and stack the green block on the red block.

stack_bowls_three.instruction: Stack the three bowls on top of each other.

stack_bowls_two.instruction: Stack the two bowls on top of each other.

stamp_seal.instruction: Grab the stamp and stamp it onto the target colored mat.

turn_switch.instruction: Use the arm to click the switch.
